shots.name: Shooter lane / Plunge
shots.notes: Auto + manual plunge; used for all 8 skill shots and the MXV super skill shot.

shots.name: Left orbit
shots.notes: Far-left lane wrapping over the top to the bumpers; used in DB5 Q Branch mode (alternate with DB5 eject).

shots.name: Left ramp
shots.notes: Steep left-center ramp (Commander Bond skill shot), gated by the spinner; starts Jetpack Multiball and its double jackpot. Shot from the lower-left flipper; feeds the right flipper.

shots.name: Spinner
shots.notes: Diamonds Are Forever optical spinner at the mouth of the left ramp; 200 spins = Tatiana... actually Tiffany Case Bond Woman; boosts DB5-mode jackpots +3k/spin.

shots.name: Left eject
shots.notes: The Swamp, tucked below the upper-left flipper. Licensed To Kill skill shot; qualifies Jetpack Multiball; 4 ejects = Domino Derval; High Stakes mystery award.

shots.name: Rocket lane
shots.notes: Left of the Osato drops running up to Bird One. Shoot to spot SPECTRE letters; 20 shots qualifies Little Nellie; rocket hits count toward Kissy Suzuki.

shots.name: Osato Chemicals drop targets
shots.notes: 3-drop bank in front of the Bird One rocket; complete to light Bird One lock; 40k/drop boosts Little Nellie jackpots.

shots.name: SPECTRE standup targets
shots.notes: Seven standups around the rocket; light SPECTRE weapons and add +25k per hit to Bird One base jackpots.

shots.name: Bird One rocket
shots.notes: Back-left super-jackpot target for Bird One Multiball (cap ~300M). Premium/LE = motorized moving rocket with physical Swipe-A-Ball lock; Pro = static molded rocket with virtual lock at the center loop.

shots.name: Center loop
shots.notes: Center lane between rocket and Dragon Tank; primary Bird One lock shot and Jetpack hurry-up (center-lane) shot; reliably feeds the upper flipper for combos.

shots.name: Dr. No Dragon Tank
shots.notes: Custom molded target with a standup on the hood; 5 hits light an outlane ball save; Premium/LE Jetpack super jackpot is scored here. Deadly reject/center-drain hazard when no multiball is running.

shots.name: Jetpack
shots.notes: Premium/LE = magnetic arm that physically carries the ball over the Dragon Tank for the super jackpot; Pro = non-moving diverter with a roving super-jackpot shot instead.

shots.name: MI6 top lanes
shots.notes: Top rollover lanes above the bumpers; Classified/MI6 skill shots; complete (flipper-changeable) to advance the end-of-ball bonus multiplier.

shots.name: Pop bumpers
shots.notes: Two Dr. No pop bumpers, upper-center; 25 hits = Honey Ryder, 25 hits qualifies Radioactive Reconnaissance; Top Secret skill shot via the bumper lane.

shots.name: Upper loop
shots.notes: Top/upper-right, shot from the upper-left flipper; collect flashing Bond Women here to make them solid; part of the MXV super skill shot; the combo 'Side loop'.

shots.name: Side ramp
shots.notes: Henchmen ramp; upper entrance reachable only from the upper flipper. Starts henchmen modes (Double O skill shot); scores 2x in every SPECTRE countdown; super-jackpot shot in most multiballs/wizards. Bricking it feeds the Martini shot.

shots.name: Goldfinger target
shots.notes: Between side ramp and right orbit; when flashing, rotates the lit mode set and starts SPECTRE weapon countdowns; also changes the currently-lit villain/henchman mode.

shots.name: Right orbit
shots.notes: Between the two right-ramp entrances, wraps to the top; first shot of the MXV super skill shot; 3 shots = Tatiana Romanova; qualifies Attaché Case (6 shots).

shots.name: Right ramp
shots.notes: Villain ramp; main lower entrance from the lower-right flipper; primary villain-mode starter (Dr. No/Goldfinger/Thunderball); feeds the left flipper for ramp-to-ramp combos.

shots.name: DB5 eject
shots.notes: Aston Martin DB5 ejector-seat scoop; starts Q-Branch gadget modes (Eyes Only skill shot); 4 ejects = Pussy Galore; 3 ejects qualifies the DB5 Q Branch mode.

shots.name: Left inlane / outlane
shots.notes: Left drain lanes flanking the lower-left flipper; BOND return-lane completions feed the bonus multiplier and High Stakes; Dragon Tank hits light an alternating outlane ball save.

shots.name: Right inlane / outlane
shots.notes: Right drain lanes flanking the lower-right flipper; part of the alternating outlane ball save lit by Dragon Tank hits.

shots.name: Upper-left flipper
shots.notes: Mid-left flipper pointing up-and-right; the only way to reach the side ramp, upper loop, right orbit and bumper lane. Source of the MXV super skill shot and Double O / Top Secret shots.

drills.title: Plunge Into the Swamp
drills.text: Send the ball straight into the left eject off the plunge with no flipper held. It pays the skill shot and lights the left ramp for the multiball in the same motion, which makes it the highest-value opener you can make without touching a flipper.

drills.title: Ramp Crossfeed
drills.text: Shoot the left ramp, take the return on the opposite flipper, and put it straight up the right ramp. Both ramps feed the other flipper, so the pair is the reliable chain-starter on this machine and the one to have automatic.

drills.title: Upper Flipper Map
drills.text: Feed the upper flipper off the center loop, cradle, and take one of its shots per trip — the side ramp, the upper loop, the right orbit. The side ramp cannot be reached any other way, so time spent learning this flipper is time spent unlocking half the mode structure.

drills.title: Tank Discipline
drills.text: Take the Dragon Tank only when a mode demands it or a multiball is covering you, and count the five hits that light the outlane save while you are there. Cold attempts at it and the center loop beside it are the main center-drain on the machine.

drills.title: The Deliberate Brick
drills.text: Shoot the side ramp softly on purpose so it fails to make it and rolls back down to register the right ramp. Dialling in a shot weak enough to fall back but strong enough to reach the ramp is a real power-control exercise, and it pays.

drills.title: Collect Up Top
drills.text: Qualify a Bond Woman off bumper hits or right-orbit shots, then collect the flashing insert at the upper loop, and cradle before you spend anything. Draining with them collected and uncashed loses the lot, so the discipline is banking them rather than gathering them.

actionButton.label: Action Button
actionButton.how: One button with several jobs, and the flippers decide which one is loaded. Its color is the tell: pink runs 007 Scoring, blue fires a smart missile, green swipes a ball out of the Bird One rail on Premium and LE. Look at the color before you press, because the wrong award at the wrong moment is a real loss here.

uses.when: Two or more Bond Women collected
uses.what: Press pink for 007 Scoring: +1x per Woman up to 7x, running 20 seconds at 2x out to 70 seconds at 7x.

uses.when: Jetpack or Bird One multiball running
uses.what: Start 007 Scoring there so the playfield multiplier lands on your biggest jackpots.
A tap collects a lit shot and takes the hardest one available; up to four missiles stack.
A long press cashes the add-a-ball that mode qualified.

uses.when: Ball sitting in the Bird One rail (Prem/LE)
uses.what: Switch to green and press to swipe it back into play, once per multiball.
Tap a flipper to rotate between missile, swipe-a-ball, and 007 Scoring before you commit.

howItPlays.objective: Run the Bond films across four feature categories -- villains, henchmen, SPECTRE weapons, and Q-Branch gadgets -- while collecting Bond Women for a playfield multiplier. Play a mini-wizard in each category to unlock the final On Her Majesty's Secret Service wizard.
loop: Plunge into the left eject for the Licensed To Kill skill shot -- it banks a smart missile and lights Jetpack Multiball in one shot.
Kick off a villain mode from the right ramp or a henchman mode from the upper-flipper side ramp, then fold it into Jetpack Multiball.
Qualify Bond Women through bumper, spinner, orbit, and eject progress, make them solid at the upper loop, then hit the pink lockbar button to run a timed multiplier over your biggest jackpots.
Pre-load the SPECTRE targets, break the Osato drops, and lock three at the rocket for Bird One Multiball and its huge super jackpot.
Play a mini-wizard in each of the four categories to arm the final wizard.

lights.name: MI6 Top Lanes
lights.lit: A lit MI6 top lane is one you still need, and completing the set is what steps your end-of-ball bonus multiplier -- these rollovers also award the Classified and MI6 skill shots off the plunge.

control.effect: a tap of either flipper shifts which of the MI6 top-lane rollovers are lit, so you can slide an uncompleted lane under the ball instead of steering it through the bumpers
control.when: as the ball rolls through the top lanes above the bumpers

lights.then: Shift the lit lanes onto the ball's path and complete the set to climb the bonus multiplier toward its five-times ceiling. Those BOND return lanes pour into the same multiplier at double weight, and every other BOND finish arms the High Stakes mystery over at the left eject.

lights.name: 007 Scoring / Bond Women
lights.lit: Bond Women qualify through feature progress -- twenty-five bumper hits, three right-orbit shots, ejects, spinner spins -- each lighting a flashing insert at the upper loop that you collect there to make solid.
lights.then: With two or more Women banked, press the pink action button to run a two-times-to-seven-times playfield multiplier for twenty to seventy seconds, ideally over a multiball's jackpots. Draining while that button is flashing loses the multiplier and every Woman you collected, so cradle up before you fire it.

lights.name: Jetpack Multiball
lights.lit: The left eject (the Swamp) lights the left-ramp lock, and the lit left ramp starts the two-ball Jetpack Multiball -- the fastest guaranteed points on the game.
lights.then: Rush the center lane to bank the hurry-up value before it ticks down, since that number sets how big every jackpot in the multiball is. After five jackpots the left ramp pays a double, then a super with an added ball.

lights.name: Bird One Multiball
lights.lit: Hitting the SPECTRE standups first raises the base jackpot, the Osato drop bank lights the lock when cleared, and three locks at the center loop or rocket start a multiball that puts up the biggest single numbers anywhere on this playfield.
lights.then: Pre-load the SPECTRE targets, break the drops, and lock three, then collect the green jackpots single, double, then triple. Rip the rocket for a super jackpot that caps near three hundred million.

lights.name: Villain & Henchman Ramps
lights.lit: The right ramp starts a villain mode and the upper-flipper side ramp starts a henchman mode, while a flashing Goldfinger target rotates which villain or henchman is lit and kicks off SPECTRE weapon countdowns.
lights.then: Rotate which mode is lit using the bumpers or that Goldfinger target to spread your progress around, and finish each mode for a smart missile. Starting all six villains off the right ramp and all the henchmen off the side ramp carries you to those two category mini-wizards.

lights.name: SPECTRE Weapons
lights.lit: Shots to the rocket lane spot SPECTRE letters one at a time and the standups light the weapons, and a flashing Goldfinger target starts the weapon countdown once you are spelled up.
lights.then: Spell SPECTRE and start a weapon such as Outer Space Hijack, then finish it with six rocket hits -- the first three from the rocket lane or standups, the last three off the drops. Each completed weapon qualifies an add-a-ball at the action button and steps you toward the weapon-category mini-wizard.

lights.name: Q-Branch Ejects
lights.lit: Three DB5 ejects qualify the DB5 gadget mode and three left ejects qualify the Power Pack mode, both counts carrying across balls, and every eject also chips toward a Bond Woman.
lights.then: Convert either Q-Branch mode into a two-ball multiball -- rip the spinner to pump the DB5 jackpots, or work white-arrow shots to raise Power Pack -- then shoot its eject for the super jackpot. Keep feeding both ejects all game to reach the gadget-category mini-wizard.

howItPlays.laneChangeNote: Tap either flipper to shift which of the MI6 top-lane rollovers are lit, so you can complete the set by sliding an uncompleted lane under the ball rather than steering it through the bumpers. Each completion steps the end-of-ball bonus multiplier toward its five-times cap, with each BOND return-lane finish worth a double step.

scoring.text: Plunge straight into the left eject for Licensed To Kill -- it banks a smart missile and lights Jetpack in a single shot. Then take the right ramp to open a villain mode, and the left ramp to launch Jetpack Multiball with that mode folded in, so your safest ramps double as your fastest points.

Qualify Bond Women through bumper, spinner, orbit, and eject progress and cash them at the upper loop, working toward the 007 multiplier. Spread progress across all four feature categories -- villains off the right ramp, henchmen off the side ramp, weapons at the rocket lane, gadgets at the ejects -- and pre-load the SPECTRE targets before you start Bird One.

Build the 007 multiplier to seven-times, then run the Bond... James Bond mini-wizard: one giant lap of all ten shots into a super jackpot that sums every jackpot you have banked, which can clear a billion under the multiplier. Play a mini-wizard in each of the four categories and the final wizard, On Her Majesty's Secret Service, opens -- six flip-budget film stages into MI6 Multiball to end the game.
